Oct 18, 2026[### Investing in the public benefit

We’re committing a portion of Anthropic’s shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows.](/news/public-benefit-fund)

[Announcements](/news/announcements)

Oct 26, 2026[### Anthropic files S-1 with the SEC for proposed initial public offering

Today, Anthropic, PBC filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission relating to its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.](/news/s1-sec)

[Science](/science)

Oct 27, 2026[### Early progress on accelerating drug development with Claude

We're at the start of a major effort to speed up drug development with Claude. Over the past several months, our scientists have engaged in deep research partnerships with six organizations developing new medicines.](/research/early-progress-drug-development)

[Announcements](/news/announcements)

Oct 7, 2026[### Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5

Claude Haiku 5.5 is our fastest, most capable small model. Built for high-volume work like summarization, subagents, and browser use.](/claude-haiku-5-5)

[Announcements](/news/announcements)

Sep 22, 2026[### Introducing Claude Opus 5.5

Claude Opus 5.5 leads in agentic coding and knowledge work, and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5 on typical workloads.](/claude-opus-5-5)
